note: Ratchet for the structural code report (`./gradlew :worker:structureReport`). Every number below is production code that ships and does nothing: classes nothing references, methods only tests call, methods no entry point can reach, methods too big for the JIT, and severe in-loop cost findings. They may only go DOWN — raising a limit to make a build green defeats the point of measuring, so a rise fails the task. The task prints the tightened set whenever the tree improves; paste it here in the same commit.
measured: 2026-08-06 on the MERGED round-2 tree (Plan 11 round 2: #210 dead clusters, #212 test consolidation, #213 rust services, #214 frontend+gates, plus the frame helper), re-measured by `./gradlew :peer:structureReport` on the merge commit rather than carried over from any one branch. never_referenced_methods 91 -> 4, unreachable_methods 264 -> 117, test_only_methods 415 -> 318, test_only_classes 29 -> 12, severe_cost_findings 4 -> 3. The merged figures are identical to the dead-cluster branch's own stamp -- the test consolidation that landed alongside it moved none of these counters -- but that had to be measured, not assumed: a ratchet file describes one tree, and two branches each describe a tree that stops existing at the merge. never_referenced_methods at 4 has no headroom; the four are documented in STRUCTURE.md and each is a filed defect kept fixable-by-wiring rather than deleted.
